spots.line: Nets on every frame, and every frame turned away from the water.
A keel laid down years ago. Nobody has added a rib to it since.
The shingle is scraped smooth where the boats used to be dragged up.

chests.line: A salt barrel with a false bottom, which is exactly where you looked.
A sea chest come in on the tide, still locked, still heavy.

people.name: Gill the Cabin Hand
chatter: Every net on the frames and not one of them wet since spring.
Halbrec says the tide brings things back. He never says what.

people.name: a gull with a temper
chatter: It has taken two hats and a knife off this beach today.

people.name: Nettle the Cutpurse
chatter: There is no law down here, only tide tables.
Count your coin before the shingle and after it.
